# Introduction

This Quarto document is a placeholder for your analysis report.  You can
embed text, code chunks, and figures.  The pipeline defined in
`_targets.R` should generate all necessary intermediate data; in this
document you can read those data via the targets API or by loading
files under `data/processed/`.

```{r}
#| label: use-targets
# Read targets produced by the pipeline (run after tar_make)
spd_tbl <- targets::tar_read(spd_summary)
fd_tbl  <- targets::tar_read(fd_summary)
kde_tbl <- targets::tar_read(kde_summary)
str(list(spd = spd_tbl, fd = fd_tbl, kde = kde_tbl))
```
